It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1931.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=6 May 2020}} The district consists of the city of [[Baybay]] and adjacent municipalities of [[Abuyog]], [[Bato, Leyte|Bato]], [[Hilongos]], [[Hindang]], [[Inopacan]], [[Javier, Leyte|Javier]], [[Mahaplag]] and [[Matalom]], since its second restoration in 1987. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Carl Cari]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]].{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=6 May 2020}} Prior to its second dissolution in 1961 due to the creation of [[Southern Leyte]], the district consisted of the central municipalities of [[Alangalang]], [[Barugo]], [[Burauen]], [[Capoocan]], [[Carigara]], [[Dagami]], [[Jaro, Leyte|Jaro]], [[Julita, Leyte|Julita]], [[La Paz, Leyte|La Paz]], [[Pastrana, Leyte|Pastrana]], [[Tabontabon]], and [[Tunga, Leyte|Tunga]].
